newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Oct output jump aided by ships, power.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Oct output jump aided by ships, power.

text.p: Croatia's industrial output jumped 13.1 percent in October from September and 9.4 percent from the same month of 1995 with the help of a strong rise in shipbuilding and power sectors.
According to official statistics, January-October output was 3.3 percent higher than a year earlier as 18 out of 34 branches increased production.
Shipyards recorded the biggest boom in the industrial recovery, with a rise of 35.7 percent in January-October orders.
But food production, which represents some 16 percent of the total, edged up by a modest 0.3 percent.
Energy was up 24.9 percent and construction materials 28.2 percent as the country pressed on with rebuilding projects in areas devastated by war.
But output continued to decline in the once prosperous machinery, textiles, leather and footwear manufacturing. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
